# The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Phases & Roadmap

By Serenal Updated: 2026/04/15

Live

Serenal

[Live on Twitch!](https://www.twitch.tv/seren_wow) Offline on Twitch

Follow:

Follow [](https://www.twitch.tv/seren_wow) [](https://twitter.com/seren_gaming) [](https://www.youtube.com/@seren-wow)

World of Warcraft Classic released its 20th Anniversary Edition on November 21, 2024. This started characters at the beginning of the Classic experience on fresh servers, which are now progressing into The Burning Crusade.  
  
This guide lists all the phases of The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary with launch times, what they contain, and links to relevant guides once they become available.

Show Table of Contents

## Roadmap and Release Schedule for TBC Classic Anniversary

When the WoW Classic 2026 Roadmap becomes available you will find it here.

### The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Release Date

TBC Classic Anniversary Released on February 5th 2026.  
  
**The TBC Classic Anniversary Phase 2 will launch May 14th, 2026**

  
  
### Next Phase: TBC Classic Anniversary Phase 2 - May 14th, 2026

  
  
[TBC Roadmap](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/1267797.jpg)

## TBC Classic Anniversary Servers

The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary servers will be the existing WoW Classic Servers, progressing. These servers were launched on November 21st, 2024.  
  
Unlike in 2019, some changes were made at launch, as per below.

* Reporting system improvements
* The Dethroning system for transferring guild leadership
* The addition of the [Chronoboon Displacer Chronoboon Displacer](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/item=184937/chronoboon-displacer) with up to 10 stacks
* Improved PvP Honor Ranking system (starts in Phase 2)
* Graphics improvements
* Instant mail between characters on the same account
* Removal of the buff/ debuff limit
* Dual Spec

### TBC Classic Anniversary Server List

|Region |Name |Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
|EU |Spineshatter |PvP |
|EU |Thunderstrike |PvE |
|NA |Nightslayer |PvP |
|NA |Dreamscythe |PvE |
|AU - NA |Maladath |PvP |

  
  
Hardcore Servers, Doomhowl (NA), and Soulseeker (EU) are confirmed to remain at WoW Classic. Players can choose to transfer to PvE should they wish to continue on to The Burning Crusade Classic.

### PvP Server Balance

PvP server balance will be maintained to enforce a balance between Horde and Alliance, ensuring that neither side has the strength of numbers necessary to steamroll the other side. If the realm appears to be tipping out of balance, character creation for the larger side will be suspended until the numbers are brought back into parity. This was introduced in Season of Discovery and has been overwhelmingly popular.

### No GDKP Points Allowed

Within the NA and EU regions, GDKP (Gold Dragon Kill Points) will not be allowed on The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary.

## Phase Releases for The Burning Crusade Anniversary

The phase releases will be identical to those introduced both in the original Vanilla WoW and WoW Classic. Different zones, big mobs, and systems will be unveiled every few months during the run of the 20th Anniversary Edition.  
  
This list will be updated as new dates are published.

|**Content** |**Phases** |**Release Date/ Time** |
| --- | --- | --- |
|Leveling Updates, Draenei and Blood Elves, Jewelcrafting, |Pre Patch |January 13th, 2026 |
|Level Cap increased, New Dungeons, Heroic Dungeons, Karazhan, Gruul's Lair, and Magtheridon, Outland Zones |Phase 1 |February 5th, 2026 |
|Serpentshrine Cavern, Tempest Keep Raids, Profession Updates |Phase 2 |May 14th, 2026 |
|Mount Hyjal, and Black Temple Raids, |Phase 3 |Summer |
|Zul'Aman |Phase 4 |Autumn |
|Magister's Terrace (Dungeon) Sunwell Plateau (Raid) Isle of Quel'Dan Daily Quest Hub |Phase 5 |Autumn |

### Pre-Patch: New Races, Faster Leveling, Class Changes

#### * _When: January 13th_
* _Blood Elves, Draenei, Jewelcrafting, Faster Leveling_

The Burning Crusade Pre-Patch is quite an expansion event in itself, including new races—Blood Elf for the Horde and Draenei for the Alliance—and bringing Paladins to the Horde and Shaman to the Alliance for the first time. Also included are new starter zones and home cities, Silvermoon City, and The Exodar.  
  
[Silvermoon City](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/80268.jpg) [The Exodar](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/65542.jpg)

  
  
Leveling is sped up in the pre-patch. The experience required per level is reduced by 15% from level 20-60, while the experience gained from completing quests from level 30 is also increased (dungeon quests even more so).  
  
[Blood Elf and Draenei Leveling Guides](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/news/blood-elf-and-draenei-speed-leveling-guides-for-burning-crusade-classic-322342)

  
  
Players will be able to obtain mounts earlier, and the cost will be reduced.  
  
Jewelcrafting is a new profession introduced in the pre patch and players can level it to 300.  
  
[Jewelcrafting Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/guide/professions/jewelcrafting-overview) [Leveling Jewelcrafting 1-300](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/guide/jewelcrafting-leveling-1-300-burning-crusade-classic) [Jewelcrafting 1-300 Designs](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/guide/jewelcrafting-recipes-locations-1-300-burning-crusade-classic)

### Phase 1: Leveling, New Zones, Raids, Dungeons, Heroics, Reputations

#### * _When: February 5th, Raids Coming on February 19th_
* _Introduces: Karazhan, Gruul's Lair, and Magtheridon Raids_

Phase One of The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary will be your chance to visit Outland and level from 60-70. Once at level 70, you will be kept busy amassing reputation with factions before you can begin grinding Heroic dungeons and attunement chains.  
  
[Karazhan](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/21976.jpg) [Karazhan](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/21973.jpg) [Karazhan](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/21975.jpg)

  
  
  
### Phase 2: Serpentshrine Cavern, Tempest Keep

#### * _When: May 14th, 2026_
* _Introduces: Serpentshrine Cavern, Tempest Keep_

The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary is full of content and Phase 2 is no different. This phase brings with it two raids, each with their own exciting attunement quest line.  
  
[The Burning Crusade Phase 2 Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/guide/phase-two-updates-overview)

  
  
[Phase Two Raids](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/25708.jpg) [Phase Two Raids](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/64112.jpg) [Phase Two Raids](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/66707.jpg)

### Phase 3: Mount Hyjal, Black Temple

#### * _When: Summer_
* _Introduces: Mount Hyjal, Black Temple_

Phase 3 is where the attunements begin tapering off in TBC Classic, and players who come late will be able to enter the Phase 2 raids even without being fully attuned. At this point, the reputation required to enter Heroics is also lowered to Honored (from Revered).  
  
[Black Temple](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/64711.jpg) [Black Temple](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/34957.jpg) [Black Temple](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/34955.jpg)

### Phase 4: Zul'Aman

#### * _When: Autumn_
* _Introduces: Zul'Aman_

Zul'Aman is a catch-up raid designed to offer a way for alts and newer players to gear up and catch up to current content. Not only that but players can speed-run it to get the [Amani War Bear Amani War Bear](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/item=33809/amani-war-bear) .  
  
[Zulaman](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/63162.jpg) [Zulaman](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/63157.jpg) [Zulaman](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/63169.jpg)

  
  
  
### Phase 5: Sunwell Plateau, Isle of Quel'Danas

#### * _When: Autumn_
* _Introduces: Sunwell Plateau Raid, Magisters Terrace Dungeon, Isle of Quel'Danas Quest Hub_

The final Phase of The Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary will bring with it the opportunity for players to kill Kil'Jaeden within the Sunwell Plateau. Situated on the Isle of Quel'Danas players will complete Daily Quests to progress the Shattered Sun Offensive further. This zone also brings a 5-player dungeon Magister's Terrace. Magister's Terrace primarily acts as a gear catch-up but is both fun and challenging.  
  
[Sunwell](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/72233.jpg) [Sunwell](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/72967.jpg) [Sunwell](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/72970.jpg)

## Serenal

### Guide Manager, Wowhead Classic Division

Serenal has been playing World of Warcraft since the tail end of Vanilla and has a long history of competitive gameplay. In Wrath of the Lich King, she earned realm first titles Celestial Defender and The Magic Seeker, and led a successful raiding and PvP guild from Wrath through Mists of Pandaria. This guild achieved Top 100 raid kills and earned Hero of the Alliance three times during Cataclysm.  
  
Today, Serenal focuses on gold-making, professions, and collecting, sharing insights through her YouTube channel, Seren Games, and as a Wowhead guide writer with over 75 published guides.

# BCC Anniversary Edition: Black Temple Arrives August 27

Classic Anniversary

July 23, 2026 by [Blizzard Entertainment](https://worldofwarcraft.com/search/blog?a=Blizzard%20Entertainment)

[55](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/2329545)

Share

Tweet

[55 Comments](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/2329545)

Illidan Stormrage has claimed the Black Temple as his fortress and is amassing an army of fel warriors in his pursuit of power. Infiltrate the Black Temple and face the Betrayer in _Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary_ !

> **Global Launch** : August 27 at 3:00 pm PDT / 23:00 BST
> 
> 

* * *

## Your Journey Ahead

* **New Raids** : Black Temple (Illidan the Betrayer) and The Battle for Mount Hyjal (Archimonde)
* **New Daily Faction and Quest Hub** : The Netherwing in Shadowmoon Valley
* **Arena Season 3** : Earn new rewards, updated progression, and more gear from Outland quartermasters.
* **Epic Gems** : Enhance your gear!

* * *

## Storm Two Legendary Raids

Journey into the heart of Outland's most dangerous conflicts as two legendary raids open their gates once more. Along the way, earn faction reputation, claim powerful rewards, and overcome unforgettable boss encounters.

### Confront the Betrayer in The Black Temple

Storm the shadowed halls of the Black Temple and confront Illidan Stormrage in his seat of power.

[](https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/fp/FPWCVVKTD3T11784221575221.jpg)

* **Level** : 70
* **Location** : Shadowmoon Valley, Outland
* **Reputation** : Ashtongue Deathsworn
* **Boss Encounters** : High Warlord Naj'entus, Supremus, Shade of Akama, Teron Gorefiend, Gurtogg Bloodboil, Reliquary of Souls, Mother Shahraz, The Illidari Council, and Illidan Stormrage

Before you can enter the Black Temple, you'll need to complete the attunement process—learn how in [this guide](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/guide/attunement-dungeons-raids-burning-crusade-classic?brl) .

Improve your standing with the Ashtongue Deathsworn and earn additional rewards from Okuno within the Black Temple.

### Stand Against Archimonde in The Battle for Mount Hyjal

Journey through the Caverns of Time to preserve the outcome of the pivotal Battle for Mount Hyjal and ensure Archimonde meets his fated end.

[](https://bnetcmsus-a.akamaihd.net/cms/content_entry_media/g9/G9YDMOWFCBGO1784221646386.jpg)

* **Level** : 70
* **Location** : Caverns of Time, Tanaris
* **Reputation** : Scale of the Sands
* **Boss Encounters** : Rage Winterchill, Anetheron, Kaz'rogal, Azgalor, and Archimonde

To enter the Battle for Mount Hyjal, complete the “ [The Vials of Eternity](https://www.wowhead.com/tbc/quest=10445/the-vials-of-eternity?brl) ” questline.

Improve your standing with the Scale of the Sands and earn rewards from Indormi within the Battle for Mount Hyjal raid instance. You do not need to be in a raid group to enter.

* * *

## Earn the Trust of the Netherwing

Begin earning Netherwing reputation through daily quests on Netherwing Ledge, the floating crystalline outpost high above southeastern Shadowmoon Valley. Flying mounts are a must to reach it—or a willingness to take a very strategic fall.

Upon arrival, complete daily quests to earn reputation with the Netherwing. Collect Netherwing Eggs along the way to accelerate your reputation gains.

Once you reach Exalted with the Netherwing, you can obtain epic Netherwing Drake mounts ( [Azure](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Reins_of_the_Azure_Netherwing_Drake?brl) , [Cobalt](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Reins_of_the_Cobalt_Netherwing_Drake?brl) , [Onyx](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Reins_of_the_Onyx_Netherwing_Drake?brl) , [Purple](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Reins_of_the_Purple_Netherwing_Drake?brl) , [Veridian](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Reins_of_the_Veridian_Netherwing_Drake?brl) , and [Violet](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Reins_of_the_Violet_Netherwing_Drake?brl) ) from Drake Dealer Hurlunk in the Dragonmaw Base Camp, provided the required Artisan Riding skill is achieved, and the “Blood Oath of the Netherwing,” part of the Netherwing questline is completed.

Quest givers and merchants can also be found mingling in the camp, including Gug the Armorsmith, Horus the Innkeeper, and Rumpus for your poison and reagent needs.

* * *

## Enhance Your Gear with Epic Gems

Earn epic gems through mining in the Battle for Mount Hyjal with a Mining skill of 375, or discover them as rare drops within the Black Temple.

Looking to enhance your gear with epic gems? Purchase Jewelcrafting Designs from Indormi, Keeper of Ancient Gem Lore, inside the Battle for Mount Hyjal raid instance.

* * *

## Prove Your Worth in Arena Season 3

Arena Season 2 ends on August 18 (with weekly realm restarts). Prepare for a new season of competition as Arena Season 3 begins, bringing new rewards and the latest Arena gear available from vendors in Shattrath and Nagrand.

> **When** : September 1 (with weekly realm restarts)
> 
> 

At the end of Season 2, any remaining unspent Arena Points are converted to Honor Points (1 Arena Point = 10 Honor Points), and Arena Season 2 gear will be available from Area 52 vendors at a discount, with no Arena rating requirement. Arena Season 1 gear will also become available from Honor vendors in the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar and the Champion’s Hall in Stormwind.

* * *

The Betrayer awaits. Rally your allies, steel your resolve, and prepare to face Illidan Stormrage within the Black Temple.

# WoW Classic Fresh Launch Roadmap - 20th Anniversary

By RenataKane Updated: 2025/09/19

World of Warcraft Classic released its 20th Anniversary Edition on November 21, 2024. This started characters at the very beginning of the Classic experience on fresh servers, including Hardcore servers for players who like the ultimate challenge: risk of permanent character death. The release schedule shows the phases and their estimated release times.  
  
This guide lists all the phases of WoW Classic Fresh with launch times, what they contain, and links to relevant guides.

Show Table of Contents

## Roadmap and Release Schedule for WoW Classic 20th Anniversary

### Next Phase: Phase 6, October 2nd, 2025

  
  
[World of Warcraft Classic Roadmap from Warcraft Direct](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/1199539.jpg)

## Fresh WoW Classic and Classic Hardcore Servers

All servers in the 20th Anniversary Edition were fresh, meaning everyone started over as Day 1. This corresponds to Patch 1.12 in the original release.  
  
Classic Anniversary released with only 1 realm from each ruleset (Normal PvE, PvP, and Hardcore) for a total of 3 realms. If needed, more servers will open to accommodate more players based on demand. However, Blizzard has stated that they intend to open to as few servers as possible.  
  
While Classic kept the #NoChanges philosophy overall, the quality of life improvements introduced in the original WoW Classic were available at day 1. These included:

* Reporting system improvements
* The Dethroning system for transferring guild leadership
* The addition of the [Chronoboon Displacer Chronoboon Displacer](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=184937/chronoboon-displacer) with up to 10 stacks
* Improved PvP Honor Ranking system (starts in Phase 2)
* Graphics improvements
* Instant mail between characters on the same account
* Removal of the buff/ debuff limit

Dual spec was introduced early in Phase 1.  
  
Finally, character transfers among the new realms are locked between Normal and PvP realms. The only character transfers allowed is from Hardcore (living or dead) to non-Hardcore PvE or PvP realms.

### Looking for Group Tools in WoW Classic

Since the realms are much larger than before, Blizzard has a Looking for Group tool available from the start, which allows players to create, join, and browse parties manually. There is also a Services chat channel for advertising services such as portals, summons, and tribute buffs. Interactions in this channel are subject to normal player reports and actions taken by Blizzard.

### PvP Server Balance

PvP server balance will be maintained to enforce a balance between Horde and Alliance, ensuring that neither side has strength of numbers necessary to steamroll the other side. If the realm appears to be tipping out of balance, character creation for the larger side will be suspended until the numbers are brought back into parity. This was introduced in Season of Discovery and has been overwhelmingly popular.

### Hardcore Servers

Hardcore Servers are an important part of the 20th Anniversary Edition! Players on Hardcore will risk permanent character death for the ultimate glory and fun that Classic has to offer. One Hardcore server will be open from launch, and more will only be opened if there is more demand than the server can carry.  
  
Hardcore servers will have the same phase progression through WoW Classic Anniversary as non-Hardcore servers. However, PvP battlegrounds and Battlemasters are not available on Hardcore realms.  
  
Unlike the other non-Hardcore realms, Hardcore will not progress into Burning Crusade Classic. However, you can choose to transfer your character (living or dead) to a Normal realm if you wish to progress to TBC Classic.  
  
Other than this, the normal Hardcore rules from previous incarnations apply, such as that Paladins can't bubble hearth, Shaman can't Reincarnate, and Warlock Soulstones do not work. Please see our guide for more information about Hardcore:  
  
[Hardcore Overview for WoW Classic](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/hardcore-wow-overview)

### Progression Servers

WoW Classic 20th Anniversary Edition will conclude in Winter 2025/ Spring 2026. Normal PvE and PvP servers will then transition into a fresh version of Burning Crusade Classic.  
  
Hardcore realms will not progress into Burning Crusade Classic, as Hardcore has always been focused on the classic 1-60 experience and difficulty. Characters on Hardcore will need to transfer to a non-Hardcore realm if they wish to progress.

### No GDKP Points Allowed

Within the NA and EU regions, GDKP (Gold Dragon Kill Points) will not be allowed.  
  
  
## Phase Releases for WoW Classic Fresh

The phase releases will be identical to those introduced both in the original Vanilla WoW and WoW Classic. Different zones, big mobs, and systems will be unveiled every few months during the run of the 20th Anniversary Edition.  
  
This list will be updated as new dates are published.

|**Content** |**Phases** |**Release Time** |
| --- | --- | --- |
|Molten Core, Onyxia, Maraudon |Phase 1 |December 12, 2024 |
|Dire Maul, Azuregos, Kazzak, Honor System, PvP Rank Rewards, , Alterac Valley, Warsong Gulch |Phase 2 |January 9, 2025 |
|Blackwing Lair, Darkmoon Faire, Arathi Basin |Phase 3 |March 20th, 2025 |
|Zul'Gurub, Green Dragons |Phase 4 |May 1st, 2025 |
|AQ War Effort, AQ Raids, Tier 0.5, Loot Revamp |Phase 5 |July 10th, 2025 |
|Naxxramas, Scourge Invasion, World PvP in Silithus/ EPL |Phase 6 |October 2nd, 2025 |  
  
### Phase 1: Molten Core and Onyxia

#### * _When: December 12, 2024, 14:00 PST_
* _Introduces: Molten Core and Onyxia Raids_

Phase 1 brings the two most iconic raids of the Classic experience, **Molten Core** and **Onyxia** ! We have several guides to help you gain access and conquer these 40-player raids, yielding some of the most sought-after early treasures of the Classic experience.  
  
[Onyxia, her wings unfurled](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/76809.jpg)  
  
[Molten Core Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/molten-core-raid-overview-wow-classic) [Attunement to Molten Core](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/molten-core-attunement-wow-classic) [Onyxia's Lair Raid Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/onyxia-onyxias-lair-raid-overview-wow-classic) [Onyxia's Lair Attunement Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/onyxia-onyxias-lair-attunement-drakefire-amulet-wow-classic)  
  
  
### Phase 2: Ruins of Dire Maul

#### * _When: January 9, 2025_
* _Introduces: Dire Maul, Honor System & PvP Ranking, World Bosses Azuregos and Kazzak_
* _Warsong Gulch, and Alterac Valley coming on 16th January_

**Dire Maul** , the three-winged super-dungeon for 5 players in Feralas, is one of the best catch-up instances of the game. This dungeon contains notable profession recipes, class-related quests, and the famous Tribute Runs yielding greater rewards for those willing to take the most risk.  
  
[Warp Quarter tree boss](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/72262.jpg)  
  
[Dire Maul Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/dire-maul-dungeon-strategy-wow-classic)  
  
In addition, the **Honor System and PvP Rank Rewards** will be released for player-versus-player fun, and the World Bosses **Azuregos** and **Kazzak** will make their debut.  
  
[Azuregos the Blue Dragon](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/27290.jpg) [The Demon Lord Kazzak](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/5463.jpg)  
  
[PvP Honor Ranking System](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/pvp-honor-system-overview-wow-classic) [Azuregos and Lord Kazzak World Bosses Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/classic-wow-world-bosses-azuregos-lord-kazzak-phase-2)  
  
The first PvP battlegrounds open with Phase 2: the lower-level **Warsong Gulch** , a 10 vs. 10 player battleground for level 10-60 players, and **Alterac Valley** , a 40 vs. 40 player large-scale battleground for level 51+ players. Alterac Valley has PvE goals as well as PvP, with amazing reputation rewards that culminate in the [Stormpike Battle Charger Stormpike Battle Charger](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=19030/stormpike-battle-charger) or [Horn of the Frostwolf Howler Horn of the Frostwolf Howler](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=19029/horn-of-the-frostwolf-howler) epic mounts.  
  
[Horde Flag Room in Warsong Gulch](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/894965.jpg)  
  
[Warsong Gulch Strategy Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/warsong-gulch-battleground-strategy-wow-classic) [Alterac Valley Strategy Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/alterac-valley-battleground-strategy-wow-classic)

### Phase 3: Assault on Blackwing Lair

#### * _When: March 20th_
* _Introduces: Blackwing Lair Raid, Darkmoon Faire_

Blackwing Lair is a sprawling max-level 40-player raid in Blackrock Spire. The Lair was originally constructed by Dark Iron Dwarves but was taken over by Nefarian in his efforts to rule over Azeroth, specifically with plans to destroy Ragnaros. Attuning to Blackwing Lair gives you a shortcut to enter the raid, rather than having to go deep into Blackrock Spire to reach the entrance.  
  
[Vaelastrasz the Corrupt boss](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/1920.jpg)  
  
[Blackwing Lair Raid Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/blackwing-lair-raid-overview-classic-wow) [Blackwing Lair Attunement Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/blackwing-lair-attunement-blackhands-command-classic-wow)  
  
The final Classic battleground **Arathi Basin** joins the other battlegrounds in the rotation for PvP players. It's a 15 vs. 15 player battleground for level 20+ players. Each team captures and controls specific points around the battleground, accumulating resources until one side reaches 2000.  
  
[Horde entrance to Arathi Basin](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/857815.jpg)  
[Arathi Basin Strategy Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/arathi-basin-battleground-strategy-wow-classic)  
  
Finally, Phase 3 brings Darkmoon Faire, a monthly event that alternates locations between Elwynn Forest and Mulgore. This event includes quests, Darkmoon Faire Decks for trinkets, buffs, fortunes, and more.  
  
[Welcome to Darkmoon Faire](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/907162.jpg)  
  
[Darkmoon Faire Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/classic-darkmoon-faire)  
  
  
### Phase 4: Rise of the Blood God

#### * _When: May 1, 2025_
* _Introduces: Zu'Gurub Raid, The Dragons of Nightmare World Bosses_

**Zul'Gurub** is the first 20-player raid introduced to WoW Classic, and it's also the first to require no attunement. It's widely regarded as a catch-up raid, with difficulty and mechanics that are more friendly to players and guilds, a lot of great loot to fill in the gaps, and a shorter reset time. It also rewards two of the most coveted mounts, the [Swift Razzashi Raptor Swift Razzashi Raptor](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=19872/swift-razzashi-raptor) and the [Swift Zulian Tiger Swift Zulian Tiger](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=19902/swift-zulian-tiger) .  
  
[Hakkar](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/13358.jpg)  
[Zul'Gurub Strategy Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/wow-classic-zulgurub-overview)  
  
Ysara's four lieutenants Emeriss, Lethon, Taerar, and Ysondre enter Azeroth in Phase 4 through portals located in Duskwood, The Hinterlands, Feralas, and Ashenvale, alternating randomly among the four locations. **The Dragons of Nightmare** are powerful foes requiring large groups of well-geared, high-level players to take them down.  
  
[The Nightmare Dragon Lethon](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/30786.jpg)  
[The Dragons of Nightmare World Boss Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/dragons-of-nightmare-emeriss-lethono-taerar-ysondre-classic-wow)  
  
  
### Phase 5: The Gates of Ahn':Qiraj

#### * _When: July 10th, 2025_
* _Introduces: Ahn'Qiraj War Effort and Raid, Loot Revamp_

Help the Alliance or Horde open the Ahn'Qiraj raid by contributing to the War Effort -- and earning city reputation at the same time. Be among the first to [Bang a Gong! Bang a Gong!](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/quest=8743/bang-a-gong) once the War Effort has been completed to win the coveted [Black Qiraji Resonating Crystal Black Qiraji Resonating Crystal](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=21176/black-qiraji-resonating-crystal) and open these raids for everyone on your server. AQ has both 20-player and 40-player modes, with AQ40 offering Tier 2.5 sets. Both have mounts available that you can use only inside the raid.  
  
[The Scarab Gong in Silithus](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/886019.jpg)  
  
[Ahn'Qiraj War Effort](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/ahnqiraj-war-effort) [Bang a Gong! Scarab of the Shifting Sands Questline](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/scepter-of-the-shifting-sands-scarab-lord-legendary-mount) [Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj (20-Player)](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/ruins-ahnqiraj-aq20-overview-classic-wow) [Temple of Ahn'Qiraj (40-Player)](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/temple-ahnqiraj-aq40-overview-classic-wow)  
  
  
### Phase 6: Shadows of the Necropolis

#### * _When: October 2nd, 2025_
* _Introduces: Naxxramas Raid, World PvP in Silithus and Eastern Plaguelands, Scourge Invasion_

At last, the undead citadel Naxxramas opens in all its original glory for 40 players to test their mettle! Earn attunement by reaching Honored with the Argent Dawn and finishing a quest. This four-winged dungeon complex offers Tier 3 gear by collecting Desecrated tokens to complete class-specific quests. Storied loot such as [Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=22631/atiesh-greatstaff-of-the-guardian) (four versions for Druid, Mage, Priest, and Warlock) and [Corrupted Ashbringer Corrupted Ashbringer](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=22691/corrupted-ashbringer) could be yours.  
  
[Entrance to Naxxaramas](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/823971.jpg)  
[Naxxaramas Classic Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/naxxramas-raid-overview-wow-classic)  
  
When Naxxaramas opens, the Scourge will invade all of Azeroth. Floating necropolises will show up in high-level zones for players to battle and earn gear, with a chance of rare spawns that drop even better loot. In addition, new Scourge bosses may show up in instances across Azeroth.  
  
[Players around Scourge crystals](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/991173.jpg)  
[Scourge Invasions](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/wow-classic-scourge-invasions)  
  
Take on your fellow players in PvP in Silithus and Eastern Plaguelands. The Field Duty stations open in Silithus to challenge your mettle, earn gear, and build your reputation with Cenarion Circle. Play A Game of Towers in Eastern Plaguelands by capturing and holding towers across the zone. Holding towers opens zonewide buffs that give all members of your faction additional damage versus undead (this buff does not work inside Naxxaramas).  
  
[Attacking a boss during Field Duty in Silithus](https://wow.zamimg.com/uploads/screenshots/normal/50971.jpg)  
[Field Duty in Silithus](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/wow-classic-field-duty-cenarion-circle-silithus)

Renata (she/ her, aka Ren) wrote over 750 guides for Wowhead on many topics spread across Diablo, WoW Retail, and Classic. She began her Wowhead career writing guides for Classic in 2019, relying on material from the _World of Warcast_ podcast she'd cohosted during the original run of Vanilla. She left Wowhead in early 2026 and now works for Blizzard Entertainment.
